svg.text: Equinox data flow: Bronze, Silver, Gold and where JEV sits
Data only moves down. Bronze is never edited, Gold is built only from Silver, and JEV and the LLM reach data only through the Memory Service.
BRONZE raw, kept exactly as received, never edited
Photo, export or document in a private Supabase
schema_version, processing_status, entry_source. Changed only by
Vision / LLM reads the original and proposes candidates (labelled inferred).
The user confirms or edits before anything counts. Dataset and watch files come in through importers.
Reading the original again with a newer model adds a new record. The original is untouched.
SILVER canonical, UTC time, canonical units, deduplicated
GOLD built only from Silver. Every row keeps calculation version, evidence window, freshness and quality status
Catch: 3 Silver columns point up at Gold (symptom_checkins.triggered_by_flag_id,
appointments.brief_id, doctor_questions.brief_id). Plain uuid in E1-2, foreign key added at the end
memory_facts, memory_episodes, nudge_stats. Proposed by the
nightly reflection, typed by JEV, confirmed by the user.
proposed, then active, then superseded or rejected
MEMORY SERVICE the only door to memory (our code, not JEV)
get_context · get_timeline · get_entities · get_relationships · search_memories · propose_memory · supersede_memory. The user comes from the session, never from
arguments. Returns an evidence packet: source ids, evidence status, confidence, freshness. No names or identifiers. No free SQL for anyone.
reads views first, then timeline and entities
Doses, glucose, insights, brief charts. Code
Writes language from the evidence packet only.
No medication advice, no diagnosis, no uncited
OPERATIONS every step is logged (ids and digests only, never health values)
agent_runs · agent_steps (node = jev or memory) · guardrail_events · conversations · messages · event_log (append-only) · created in E1-3 · Hong Yi
Small typed questions answered fast, each with a confidence. JEV has no tables
of its own: it reads a short de-identified state and returns an answer. Every
1. Rules go first: urgent thresholds and refusal rules, no AI.
2. yes/no checks: asking to stop, skip or change a medicine? asking what
condition they have? urgent wording? A yes returns the safe template.
3. choice: message intent, and which memory route is needed.
4. The Memory Service then reads only that route's Gold tables (next box).
Memory route decides which Gold tables are read
entity: patient_medications, medication_ingredients, foods, meals, devices,
Low confidence: semantic plus temporal, small limits.
choice: what kind of fact is this? preference, routine, barrier, food_response,
goal or context. It sets memory_facts.category.
yes/no: does this evidence support the statement? If not, the brief sentence is
yes/no (stretch): do two facts conflict? Keep both and ask the user.
choice: prescription label, box, supplement, TCM product or food? It picks which
Silver pipeline handles the Bronze object.
A rule that fires always beats JEV.
Confidence under 0.8, or JEV down: conservative path (refusal template, 'not
Never decides: any number, threshold, baseline or food response; urgent alerts;
interaction lookup; doses or adherence; meal nutrients (the LLM estimates those,
Solid arrows: data moves. Dashed arrows: lookups, bypass or logging. Source of truth: docs/specs/data-flow.md, memory.md and schema.md.
